title: Far's Wilder Tweaks
description: This datapack makes some tweaks to many of Minecraft's biomes with new animal variants and generated features to make the world more wilder!
body:
Far's Wilder Tweaks is a datapack that adds additional tweaks like more animal variants and generated features to biomes to make them more diverse.

Animal Variants

Humid Variants - These spawn in jungles, bamboo jungles, and sparse jungles.

Chilly Variants - These spawn in taigas, old growth spruce taigas, old growth pine taigas, windswept forests, windswept hills, and windswept gravelly hills.

Dry Variants - These spawn in deserts, badlands, and eroded badlands.

Undead Variants - These spawn as jockeys, zombie chickens spawn in every biome, zombie pigs spawn in swamps and mangrove swamps, and cow husks spawn in deserts, badlands, eroded badlands, and wooded badlands.

Cat Variants - The sand cat spawns at the new dead tree structure found in deserts.

Wolf Variants - Tiger wolves spawn in eroded badlands, coastal wolves spawn in stony shores, and doge wolves spawn in cherry groves.

Zombie Nautilus Variants - The barnacle zombie nautilus spawns in cold oceans, deep cold oceans, frozen oceans, and deep frozen oceans.

Mob Spawning

Killer Bunnies now have a rare chance to spawn naturally in the world, and regular rabbits spawn in more biomes like plains, forests, birch forests, and old growth birch forests. Turtles spawn in lukewarm oceans, deep lukewarm oceans, warm oceans, and mangrove swamps. Parrots and drowned spawn in mangrove swamps.

Mob Changes

Temperate and warm chickens have recieved a model overhaul, now with a head comb and tail feathers.

Generation Changes

Certain biomes have additional environmental features, like mossy boulders in oceans, lily pads in rivers, grass in mushroom fields, and different sky and water colors.

Block Textures

Grass blocks, podzol, mycelium, crimson nylium, and warped nylium now have texture variants to make the world more lively. They can generate with flowers, clovers, mushrooms, rocks, and twigs. Lily pads also have a small lily pad variant.

IMPORTANT!

If you are downloading the datapack version, you must download and enable the Far's Wilder Tweaks resource pack in order for the animal and block texture variants to work.
